verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions workflows are YAML files stored in-repo, so they inherit full git history, branch/PR review, and revert capability like any other code (gitea-docs-1, gitea-docs-2, gitea-docs-3). This gives version control, review via pull requests, and rollback via git history for automation definitions, though Gitea provides no automation-specific rollback UI or workflow-run diffing beyond generic git tooling. Missing for 10: dedicated workflow versioning/rollback UI (e.g. one-click revert of a workflow run), independent hands-on confirmation of rolling back Actions specifically, and clarity on whether workflow run history itself (not just definitions) is preserved/reversible.
